name: Hesperian-Bajada
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by bioluminescent seas. Beyond towering mountain ranges, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
Surveyors date the derelict space station in orbit to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
